html:
East Francia was the eastern kingdom of the Franks, created by the Treaty of Verdun in 843, which grew into the Kingdom of Germany. It is on the map for 900.

Its first king was Louis the German, a grandson of Charlemagne. Its lands were made up of large duchies built on older peoples: Saxony, Bavaria, Franconia and Swabia, later joined by Lotharingia. Its eastern border faced the Slavs, including Great Moravia.

After the last Carolingian king died in 911, the dukes chose kings from among themselves. Around 900 the Magyars raided deep into the kingdom almost every year. The Saxon king Henry the Fowler built defences, and his son Otto I crushed the Magyars at the Lechfeld in 955. In 962 the pope crowned Otto emperor, and the kingdom became the heart of the Holy Roman Empire. Its western twin was West Francia.
sum: East Francia was the eastern kingdom of the Franks, created by the Treaty of Verdun in 843, which grew into the Kingdom of Germany. It is on the map for 900.
